# v0.24.7

## Changes (English)

- Reopen Existing Claude while known, fully isolated environments remain running, including through the restore action.
- Tighten the safety checks for reopening: preserve native process argument boundaries and refuse to reopen when a running process cannot be verified as a known fully isolated environment.
- Refuse to move a running environment to the Trash or permanently delete it. Deletion also stops if its running state cannot be checked.
